open_with: Open by asking Alistair for an update on the planned USD 12,000,000 charitable foundation endowment slated for 2027-01 — treat it as a forward-planning conversation ("let's make sure the mandate is built to deliver this cleanly when the time comes"), not an audit of his current positioning.
do_not_lead_with: Do not open with the gold concentration (24.0% across 3 positions/1 instrument type). He's a career commodities trader with a long track record — leading with a concentration warning will read as second-guessing his core expertise and put him on the defensive before you've established the conversation's purpose. Raise it after the foundation discussion, framed mechanically (portfolio construction ahead of a large planned outflow) rather than as a judgment on his conviction.
